title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
**BITCOIN MIDDAY BRIEF**

Bitcoin's down 2.8% to $79,382—pullback, not panic. Fear gauge sitting at 43, which is actually healthy territory after the recent run. Nothing broken here.

On-chain story's more interesting. Mempool's backed up with 154K transactions, but fees remain reasonable at 6 sat/vB for speed—network's processing fine despite congestion. Hashrate holding steady at 987 exahash, miners aren't capitulating.

Morning session was quiet. No major liquidations, no exchange outflows sc
